cache_policy.instructions: Which edge cache policy should apply to this URL?

criteria.bypass: Never cache at the edge; personalized or sensitive
criteria.short_ttl: Cache for seconds up to a few minutes
criteria.long_ttl: Cache for hours or days (static or versioned asset)
criteria.stale_while_revalidate: Serve a cached copy while refreshing it in the background

personalized.instructions: Does this response contain user-specific data?

safe_ttl.instructions: How long can this response safely be cached at a shared edge cache?
